mutable_technical_fields: host paths, virtual environments, schedulers, and implementation scripts

additional_requirements.text: After the replay script is generated at the end of the workflow (Phase 11 package, Phase 12 audit), run it once and save the replay results in a newly created separate folder, so they can be compared against the original deliverables for validation.

fixed_method_requirements.coefficient_constraint_method: Derive expected coefficient constraints only from fitted cross-sections after machine-learning selection and the declared signal-significance formula.
fixed_method_requirements.event_generation_and_detector_simulation: Generate every numerical analysis sample with MadGraph5 and run Delphes; events taken directly from an undetected LHE file are not analysis events.
fixed_method_requirements.machine_learning_event_selection: Convert Delphes LHCO events to CSV and perform final event selection with a trained machine-learning score threshold; do not replace it with a traditional hand-designed kinematic cut analysis.
fixed_method_requirements.minimum_event_statistics: With debug=false, use the locked full-size event counts as per-run scientific minima and add full-size runs and merge them whenever statistical support is not scientifically sufficient. With debug=true, use the locked reduced event counts only to test the complete workflow; do not claim strict scientific reliability from debug results.
fixed_method_requirements.phase10_publication_content: Complete every manuscript item frozen in phase10_required_manuscript_items; earlier phase evidence must support those items without adding unrelated scientific requirements.
fixed_method_requirements.strategy_comparison_method: Compare selection strategies usable under the selected debug mode only by expected coefficient-constraint interval width; AUC is descriptive or diagnostic and never a final strategy-selection criterion.
